name: features-marquee
title: Features Marquee
description: Rows of small feature chips that drift in alternating directions under a centered headline.

props.name: features
props.type: { title: string; description?: string; icon?: ReactNode }[]
props.description: Features split over the rows, filled in turn.

props.name: rows
props.description: How many rows of moving chips.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full loop of a row.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause a row while the pointer or focus is on it.

props.name: title
props.description: Section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the motion and shows the chips still.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
